templates.name: objDefault
templates.body: [(o.instanceOf.allSuperclasses.sortBy(s => s.allSuperclasses.size) + [o.instanceOf]).flatMap(k => k.attributes.filter(a => a.name != "name" and (if o[a.name] == null then false else if o[a.name] is Array then o[a.name].size > 0 else true)) + k.references.filter(r => (if o[r.name] == null then false else if o[r.name] is Array then o[r.name].size > 0 else true)))].map(fs => if fs.isEmpty then head(o) + " {}" else block(o, fs)).first

templates.name: head
templates.body: o.instanceOf.name + (if (o.instanceOf.allSuperclasses + [o.instanceOf]).flatMap(k => k.attributes).map(a => a.name).contains("name") and o.name != null then " " + nm(o.name) else "")

templates.name: feature
templates.body: if f.containment == null then attribute(o, f) else if f.containment then contained(o, f) else reference(o, f)

templates.name: attribute
templates.body: kw(o, a) + " " + (if o[a.name] is Array then "[" + o[a.name].map(v => value(a, v)).join(", ") + "]" else value(a, o[a.name]))

templates.name: contained
reference
templates.body: kw(o, r) + " " + (if o[r.name] is Array then "[" + o[r.name].map(t => ref(o, r, t)).join(", ") + "]" else ref(o, r, o[r.name]))

templates.name: value
templates.body: if enumerations.map(e => e.name).contains(a.type) then v else if v is Boolean then (if v then "true" else "false") else if v is Number then "" + v else str(v)

templates.name: ref
templates.body: if (t.instanceOf.allSuperclasses + [t.instanceOf]).flatMap(k => k.attributes).map(a => a.name).contains("name") and t.name != null and [classes.filter(c => c.name == r.type).first].map(c => if c == null then instances else c.allInstances).first.filter(x => x.name == t.name).size == 1 then nm(t.name) else path(t)

templates.name: path
templates.body: if t.parent == null then t.instanceOf.name + "[" + instances.filter(x => x.parent == null and x.instanceOf.name == t.instanceOf.name).map(x => x.id).indexOf(t.id) + "]" else path(t.parent) + "." + segment(t)

templates.name: segment
templates.body: [t.parent].map(p => (p.instanceOf.allSuperclasses + [p.instanceOf]).flatMap(k => k.references).filter(r => r.containment and (if p[r.name] is Array then p[r.name].map(x => x.id).contains(t.id) else p[r.name]?.id == t.id)).map(r => r.name + "[" + (if p[r.name] is Array then p[r.name].map(x => x.id).indexOf(t.id) else 0) + "]").first).first

templates.name: nm
templates.body: if s.matches("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$") then s else str(s)
